capital.evidence_quote: Naypyidaw is the administrative capital of Myanmar; Yangon is the historical and economic center

currency.evidence_quote: The Myanmar Kyat (MMK, K) is the official currency; market cash rates diverge from official pegs

sources.title: Department of Meteorology and Hydrology Myanmar

timezone.evidence_quote: Myanmar Standard Time is 6 hours and 30 minutes ahead of UTC year-round

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard residential supply voltage across Myanmar is 230V 50 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: Grid frequency throughout urban centers is 50 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: Combination sockets accommodate European Type C, British Type D and G, and Schuko Type F plugs

police.evidence_quote: Dial 199 for emergency police assistance throughout Myanmar

sources.title: Yangon General Hospital Emergency Medical Services

ambulance.evidence_quote: Call 192 for emergency ambulance dispatch in urban centers

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 191 for emergency fire and rescue services

tourist_police.evidence_quote: Tourist Police headquarters in Yangon operates at +95 1 642828 and in Bagan

advisory_headline.tr: Devam eden askeri çatışmalar, iç savaş ve keyfi gözaltı riski nedeniyle uluslararası dışişleri bakanlıkları Myanmar'a seyahat edilmemesini tavsiye etmektedir.
advisory_headline.en: Do Not Travel to Myanmar due to civil war, widespread armed conflict, and arbitrary enforcement of local laws.
advisory_headline.de: Reisewarnung: Vor Reisen nach Myanmar wird wegen bewaffneter Konflikte und Bürgerkrieg dringend gewarnt.
advisory_headline.ru: Категорически не рекомендуется посещать Мьянму из-за продолжающегося внутреннего вооруженного конфликта.
advisory_headline.es: No viaje a Myanmar debido al conflicto armado civil, combates y detenciones arbitrarias.

regional_warnings.area: Sagaing, Magway, Kachin, Shan, Kayah, and Rakhine States

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in Myanmar measure approximately 26.0 Mbps

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds in Yangon measure 32.0 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: MPT, Atom, and Ooredoo offer prepaid SIMs. Internet blackouts and social media blocks occur periodically. Arriving travelers must carry immaculate, uncreased US Dollar cash for currency exchange; e-Visa (evisa.moip.gov.mm) is mandatory.

sources.title: Ministry of Immigration and Population Myanmar

esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: Approved eVisa is mandatory for international commercial flight boarding to Yangon

religion.value: Theravada Buddhism (approx. 88% official predominance), Christianity (approx. 6%), and Islam (approx. 4%)
religion.evidence_quote: Theravada Buddhist monasticism permeates daily societal rituals, almsgiving, and architecture

festivals.value: Thingyan Water Festival (Buddhist New Year in April), Thadingyut Festival of Lights, Taunggyi Hot Air Balloon Festival
festivals.evidence_quote: Thingyan Water Festival heralds the new year with nationwide water cleansing celebrations

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Strict footwear etiquette: shoes, boots, and socks must be removed before entering any pagoda, temple, or monastery courtyard without exception. Never touch anyone's head or point your feet toward Buddha images or monks. Curfews are in place in major urban centers.

sources.title: Ministry of Hotels and Tourism Guidelines

legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: Footwear including socks must be removed at the outer gates of all Buddhist religious premises

tipping.value: Tipping is not customary in local tea houses or shops, but leaving 5-10% in hotel dining or tipping luggage porters (1,000-2,000 MMK) is appreciated.
tipping.evidence_quote: A modest tip is standard in hospitality and private guiding services
